documents.text: Keyes, Oklahoma Keyes is a town in Cimarron County, Oklahoma, United States. The population was 324 at the 2010 census. Keyes was established in 1925 by the Atchison, Topeka and Santa Fe Railway. The company named the town after a deceased railroad engineer. Keyes is located at . According to the United States Census Bureau, the town has a total area of , all land. As of the 2010 United States Census, there were 324 people, 131 households, and 88 families residing in the town. There were 234 housing units. The racial makeup of the town was 94.1% White, 0.6%
